text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/disburse_cycle2.py (P1): loads active households, pays each eligible one 60 dollars for cycle 2 via disburse() with the idempotency key payment_key(household.id, 2) and the operation clock (config.settings.now()), then queues a PAYMENT_SENT SMS referencing the payment.
